verdict.rationale: The pack has no documented native SMS auto-reply, missed-call text-back, after-hours text reply, or scheduled-text feature. The only related item is an API tutorial for triggering SMS programmatically, which is a developer building block. The after-hours AI Agents claim covers calls, not texts, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can send auto-replies and scheduled texts, like missed-call text-back and after-hours replies
